# Rosé Pine Moon

Rose Pine Moon brings that palette to Obsidian as a minimalist look with soft pine hues, faux-fur warmth and Soho-inspired accents. Its description records a pastel palette and refined contrast for reading and writing, and only a dark mode is listed.

![Rosé Pine Moon screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mimishahzad/rose-pine-moon-obsidian/HEAD/assets/template.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Rosé Pine Moon"
    author: "mimishahzad"
    repo:   "mimishahzad/rose-pine-moon-obsidian"
    slug:   "ros-pine-moon"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/ros-pine-moon"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/mimishahzad/rose-pine-moon-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mimishahzad/rose-pine-moon-obsidian/HEAD/assets/template.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply Rosé Pine Moon for a classy minimalist Obsidian look with soft pine hues, faux-fur warmth, and subtle Soho-inspired accents. Enjoy a gentle pastel palette and refined contrast for comfortable, elegant reading and writing."
}
```
